pixii-hand-cranked-dynamo.research_focus: Hippolyte Pixii's 1832 magneto-electric machine, its horseshoe magnet, coils and commutator, and Paris instrument workshops of the 1830s
pixii-hand-cranked-dynamo.scene: A craftsman's hand turns a crank that spins a horseshoe magnet beneath two wire-wound coils on a wooden bench, a tiny spark leaping at the commutator.

siemens-self-excited-dynamo.research_focus: Werner Siemens' 1866 dynamo-electric machine and Berlin electrical workshops of the 1860s
siemens-self-excited-dynamo.scene: A bearded engineer in a frock coat leans over a compact iron dynamo with a cylindrical armature, its field windings glowing faintly as the belt drive spins.

godalming-public-electricity-supply.research_focus: Godalming's 1881 electric street lighting, the waterwheel at Westbrook Mill on the River Wey, and Victorian English market-town streets
godalming-public-electricity-supply.scene: A waterwheel churns on a mill race at dusk while, beyond it, a Victorian town street glows under a few early electric street lamps.

pearl-street-station-opens.research_focus: Edison's Pearl Street Station in lower Manhattan, its Jumbo dynamos, steam engines and the underground conductor tubes of 1882
pearl-street-station-opens.scene: Inside a brick building, a row of massive Jumbo dynamos driven by steam engines hums, while workmen lay iron conductor tubes in a trench in the cobbled street outside.

chicago-worlds-fair-ac-power.research_focus: the 1893 World's Columbian Exposition at night, the White City's electric illumination and the Westinghouse alternating-current generators
chicago-worlds-fair-ac-power.scene: The neoclassical palaces of the White City blaze with thousands of electric bulbs reflected in a lagoon at night, crowds strolling along the water.

larderello-geothermal-plant.research_focus: Prince Piero Ginori Conti's 1904 geothermal experiment at Larderello, Tuscany, the steam vents and the small engine and dynamo that lit five bulbs
larderello-geothermal-plant.scene: In a Tuscan valley wreathed in natural steam vents, a small piston engine and dynamo stand on a rough platform, a string of a few bulbs glowing above them as men in Edwardian suits look on.

britain-national-grid-live.research_focus: the 132 kV lattice pylons of Britain's 1930s National Grid, Blomfield's pylon design, and the English countryside of the period
britain-national-grid-live.scene: A march of steel lattice pylons strides across rolling English fields and hedgerows, high-voltage lines sweeping toward a distant power station chimney.

smith-putnam-wind-turbine.research_focus: the Smith-Putnam wind turbine on Grandpa's Knob, Vermont, in 1941, its two steel blades and steel lattice tower
smith-putnam-wind-turbine.scene: A giant two-bladed steel wind turbine on a lattice tower turns on a forested Vermont hilltop in autumn, a small figure at its base for scale.

the-geysers-geothermal-plant.research_focus: PG&E's Geysers Unit 1 geothermal power plant in the Mayacamas Mountains, California, in 1960, its steam wells and pipelines
the-geysers-geothermal-plant.scene: Plumes of steam rise from wellheads on a scrubby Californian hillside as insulated pipelines snake down to a compact power plant building.

northeast-blackout-1965.research_focus: the 9 November 1965 Northeast blackout, Manhattan skyline darkened under moonlight, commuters and candlelit streets
northeast-blackout-1965.scene: The Manhattan skyline stands dark under a full moon, the only light coming from car headlights and candles flickering in apartment windows.

rance-tidal-power-station.research_focus: the Rance Tidal Power Station barrage across the Rance estuary near Saint-Malo, Brittany, in 1966
rance-tidal-power-station.scene: A long concrete barrage spans a wide Breton estuary, the incoming tide churning through its sluices while a road runs along its top.

pacific-dc-intertie-opens.research_focus: the Pacific DC Intertie high-voltage direct-current line from Celilo, Oregon, to Sylmar, California, its transmission towers and converter stations around 1970
pacific-dc-intertie-opens.scene: A single line of tall transmission towers carries heavy conductors across a high desert plain toward distant mountains, a converter station's valve hall at the line's end.

dinorwig-pumped-storage-station.research_focus: Dinorwig Power Station built inside Elidir Fawr in Snowdonia, its upper reservoir Marchlyn Mawr, the underground turbine hall and the slate quarries around it
dinorwig-pumped-storage-station.scene: A cutaway of a Welsh mountain beside old slate quarries: a reservoir sits on top, water rushes down a shaft inside, and a cavernous turbine hall is hidden deep in the rock.

quebec-geomagnetic-blackout.research_focus: the March 1989 geomagnetic storm, auroras over Quebec, and Hydro-Quebec's high-voltage transmission lines in a snowy landscape
quebec-geomagnetic-blackout.scene: An aurora ripples over snowy Quebec forest, high-voltage pylons silhouetted against it as a town below sits in total darkness.

toyota-prius-launched.research_focus: the first-generation Toyota Prius (NHW10) of 1997, its compact sedan shape and Japanese dealership showrooms of the late 1990s
toyota-prius-launched.scene: A compact first-generation hybrid sedan sits alone on a showroom turntable under spotlights, a cutaway showing a petrol engine, an electric motor and a battery pack inside. No people.

northeast-blackout-2003.research_focus: the 14 August 2003 Northeast blackout, New York streets at dusk, crowds walking home across bridges
northeast-blackout-2003.scene: Crowds of commuters walk home across a bridge toward a darkened New York skyline at dusk on a hot summer evening, traffic lights dead. Figures are small and anonymous.

tesla-roadster-deliveries.research_focus: the first-generation Tesla Roadster of 2008, its Lotus-derived low sports-car body and its battery pack of thousands of cylindrical lithium-ion cells
tesla-roadster-deliveries.scene: A low two-seat electric sports car sits in a clean garage beside a charging cable, a cutaway behind its seats revealing a pack of thousands of small cylindrical cells. No people.

tesla-powerwall-unveiled.research_focus: the first-generation Tesla Powerwall home battery of 2015, a wall-mounted unit in a suburban garage linked to rooftop solar panels
tesla-powerwall-unveiled.scene: A sleek wall-mounted battery unit hangs in a tidy suburban garage, a cable running up to solar panels on the roof seen through an open door at sunset. No people.

hornsdale-power-reserve.research_focus: the Hornsdale Power Reserve near Jamestown, South Australia, its rows of battery cabinets beside the Hornsdale wind farm
hornsdale-power-reserve.scene: Long rows of battery cabinets stand in dry South Australian farmland, wind turbines turning on the ridge behind them under a big sky. No people.

hornsea-offshore-wind-farm.research_focus: Hornsea One offshore wind farm in the North Sea off Yorkshire, its turbines, offshore substation and service vessels
hornsea-offshore-wind-farm.scene: Rows of giant wind turbines rise from a choppy North Sea swell to the horizon, a service vessel ploughing between them toward an offshore substation platform.

iberian-peninsula-blackout.research_focus: the 28 April 2025 blackout across Spain and Portugal, stalled trains, darkened Madrid or Lisbon streets and people waiting outside
iberian-peninsula-blackout.scene: A high-speed train sits stopped on an elevated track above a sunny Spanish plain, the overhead wires dead, while on a city street below traffic lights are dark and small anonymous figures wait outside shuttered shops.
